summary_en: The video features a history review program for the 2024 high school graduation exam produced by Thanh Nien Newspaper, taught by teacher Nguyen Viet Dang Du. The lectures focus on analyzing the revolutionary movements from 1930 to 1945, including the 1930-1931 movement, the 1936-1939 democratic movement, and the movement against the Japanese to save the country.
